dealSummary: AI infrastructure company SambaNova raised a $1 billion Series F at an $11 billion valuation led by General Atlantic.
Stockholm-based vibe coding startup Lovable is in talks to raise $300 million at a $13.2 billion valuation, Sifted reported.

New York-based healthcare technology company Pearl Health raised $110 million, composed of a $50 million equity round led by Andreessen Horowitz and a $60 million debt facility led by Trinity Capital.
leadInvestors: Andreessen Horowitz, a $60 million debt facility led by Trinity Capital

dealSummary: Fore Biotherapeutics, a Philadelphia-based developer of oncology treatments, raised a $67.4 million Series D-2 extension led by SR One, Medicxi and SymBiosis.
Arkenstone Defense, which helps commercial technology companies navigate government contracting, raised $35 million in seed funding led by J2 Ventures.
Miami-based Pediatrica Health Group, which provides pediatric primary care, raised a $28 million Series B led by Valspring Capital.
Velocity, which provides tools for AI-native software companies to monetize their user growth, raised $27 million in seed funding led by NFX and Red Dot Capital Partners.
Tel Aviv-based Alta, which provides a go-to-market platform for revenue teams, raised a $25 million Series A led by IN Venture.
Fleek, a London-based developer of AI infrastructure for the secondhand fashion industry, secured a $25 million Series B led by Burda Principal Investments.
London-based Axle Energy, a startup connecting home energy assets with the flexible energy market, raised a $25 million Series A led by Energize Capital.
Polysense, a Belgian developer of AI-powered quality control for food production, received $10.7 million in a round led by Felix Capital.
